info.title: hydromart-digital read API for the AI web
info.description:
HD-6, foundation (H1) and the money metrics (H2). The numbers behind the AI web's answers. Every route under /dashboard/api/v1/ai/read answers ONE envelope (AnswerEnvelope), so a metric group added later changes only metricId, value and unit. GET scope answers what the caller may read for a period; GET money?metric= (H2) answers the money metrics (sales, cash and COD, profit and loss); the other metric groups follow within version 1.

Authentication: the person's own AI-web token from POST /auth/api/v1/auth/handoff/token (auth.openapi.json): ES256, aud hydromart-ai, 15 minutes. A machine token (aud hydromart-machine) is refused with 403 whatever its scopes. The door is the aiRead capability: every staff role by default, franchise owners not.

Scope, applied in this order: (1) the person's own depots, exactly as hydromart-digital's own screens resolve them (a network-wide role: every depot); (2) narrowed to the depots whose legal entity, on a day of the period, is one the person's ROLE is granted in the role x legal entity matrix (HD-5). No grant = only SUPER_ADMIN reads it. A grant never widens step 1. The answer echoes the depots and legal entities it covered in scope. When hydromart-digital cannot work the scope out (a depot service that does not answer), nothing is answered: 503, never an answer without the narrowing.

Period: the WIB (Asia/Jakarta, UTC+7) calendar. Send period=day|week|month|year (with date, any day inside it; default today in WIB) OR from and to (YYYY-MM-DD, both days included, at most 366 days). Both or neither is a 400. Weeks run Monday to Sunday. The resolved period is always echoed back, with the same span as UTC instants (fromAt inclusive, toAt exclusive). A metric defined only over whole months or years refuses a range that is not a run of them (400).

value and status: ok = a real value, and 0 is a real value. belum_ada = there is nothing to say yet (not built, no data, not defined): value is null and reason says why; never read it as 0. ditahan = held back on purpose (masking, or a decision still open): value is null and reason says why. Quote the number from value, and the period and scope from the envelope.

Masking (owner decision 24 Nov 2026): no phone number, name or address ever leaves this API. Customers and couriers appear only as counts or opaque ids. A group of fewer than 3 people is not given as a number: its cell has value null and flag "kurang dari 3", and when a total is published beside it, the smallest other non-empty cell is held back with it (flag "ditahan") so the small cell cannot be computed back from the total; if there is no such cell the total itself is null with totalFlag "ditahan". A group of 0 people is shown as 0. Held-back cells are widened until at least 6 people are held back, so a held-back cell cannot be pinned down from the total; if the cells run out first the total is held back too. Two answers over overlapping windows are never published, because their difference would be a smaller group than either shows.

No personal data: every string, and every object key, is checked before an answer leaves. A field named phone, name, nama, address, alamat, email, hp and the like is refused, and so is any text that contains an email address or a phone number. A display name travels only under the field label. A label names a thing (a depot code, a product, a queue), never a person, and is checked like every other string. Amounts and counts are JSON numbers, never digit strings: a string of 10 to 13 digits that starts with 08, 62 or 8 reads as a phone number and is refused. A refused answer is a 500 with the fixed message "Jawaban ini tidak bisa dikirim." and never echoes what tripped the check.

Read-only: nothing is written and nothing is recorded in the audit trail. Rate limit: counted per account (the token's sub), at the edge and again in the service; a 429 carries Retry-After.

Compatibility: a field may be added within version 1, so ignore a field you do not know; removing or renaming one is a new contract version.

get.summary: How many depots the caller may read for a period, and which legal entities they belong to.
get.description: metricId meta.scope, unit depot. value is the number of depots in scope. When the caller may read no depot at all in the period the answer is status belum_ada with value null (never 0) and a reason. scope lists the depots and the legal entities they belonged to on a day of the period.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: A whole calendar period in WIB. Not together with from/to.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Any day inside the period; default today in WIB. Only with period.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day of an explicit range, with to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day of an explicit range (included), with from.

400.description: BAD_REQUEST: a period that is ambiguous (both period and from/to, or neither), not a real day, backwards, longer than 366 days, or not whole where the metric needs it.

401.description: UNAUTHORIZED: no token, an expired one, or one hydromart-digital cannot verify. Hand off again for a new token, then retry.

403.description: FORBIDDEN: a machine token, or a person whose role does not hold aiRead (a franchise owner, by default). Not worth retrying until their role changes.

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: too many calls from this account. Wait the seconds in Retry-After, then retry.

500.description: INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR: the answer was held back because it would have carried personal data (a bug in the metric, not in the request). The message is always "Jawaban ini tidak bisa dikirim."; retrying will not help.

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: the scope could not be worked out (the depot list or the legal-entity matrix could not be read). Nothing is answered rather than an answer without the narrowing. Retry later.

get.summary: One money metric (sales P-, cash and COD U-, profit and loss L-) for a period.
get.description:
The money group of the metric dictionary (sections 3.1, 3.3, 3.4). The metric is the `metric` query parameter; the answer is the AnswerEnvelope, with metricId, unit and the value shape fixed per metric in x-metrics. Amounts are whole rupiah as JSON numbers; percentages have one decimal. The period is WIB. Where a metric says "month only", an explicit from/to must be exactly one whole calendar month (400 otherwise).

Scope: every fact counts only for the days its depot was readable by the caller (a depot that changed legal entity in the period is read per stretch of days). The money metrics that are monthly profit-and-loss figures (L-01, L-03, L-06, L-07, L-08, L-09) are not cut in the middle of a month: a depot that was readable for only part of the month is left out of them, and scope lists the depots that WERE counted. When no depot is readable the answer is belum_ada.

label (optional, on the envelope): what the number is, where its name alone would mislead (for example L-03 says it is base pay and allowances only). Quote it beside the number.

People: none of these metrics counts people, so none is group-masked; the personal-data guard still runs on every answer.

Sources of truth: the numbers come from order-service, payment-service, delivery-service, depot-service and the same monthly profit-and-loss as /dashboard/network-pnl; a source that cannot answer makes the metric belum_ada (never 0). Money by payment (P-02, P-03, U-01, U-02, U-04, U-05): a delivery payment has no depot of its own, so it is placed by order-service. If order-service cannot place every delivery payment of the window, the metric is belum_ada, never a counter-only number. The 20000-order-row cap of one window is NETWORK-WIDE for delivery payments (counter payments are filtered by the depots asked); the upgrade path is an order-depot column on payments. A single answer that would need more than 300 one-depot reads is belum_ada ("persempit cakupan").

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: A metric of the money group. Any other id is 404; leaving it out is 400.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: A whole calendar period in WIB. Not together with from/to.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Any day inside the period; default today in WIB. Only with period.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day of an explicit range, with to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day of an explicit range (included), with from.

example.label: omzet: nilai yang ditagihkan dari semua pesanan kecuali batal dan void, menurut tanggal pesanan dibuat, sebelum refund, tanpa riwayat impor

400.description: BAD_REQUEST: a period that is ambiguous (both period and from/to, or neither), not a real day, backwards, longer than 366 days, or not whole where the metric needs it.

401.description: UNAUTHORIZED: no token, an expired one, or one hydromart-digital cannot verify. Hand off again for a new token, then retry.

403.description: FORBIDDEN: a machine token, or a person whose role does not hold aiRead (a franchise owner, by default). Not worth retrying until their role changes.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: a metric id that is not in the money group of the dictionary.

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: too many calls from this account. Wait the seconds in Retry-After, then retry.

500.description: INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR: the answer was held back because it would have carried personal data (a bug in the metric, not in the request). The message is always "Jawaban ini tidak bisa dikirim."; retrying will not help.

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: the scope could not be worked out (the depot list or the legal-entity matrix could not be read). Nothing is answered rather than an answer without the narrowing. Retry later.

P-01.rules: Omzet: what was billed (after every discount, with shipping and VAT) on all orders except BATAL and VOID, by the day the order was created, before refunds, live orders only (no imported history, no gallon deposit). 0 is a real answer. belum_ada only when the order source cannot be read.

P-02.rules: Refunds actually paid back, by refund date, delivery and counter orders. refundIdr counts only orders that still count as sales; refunds of cancelled (batal) and void orders are given apart in refundOfCancelledAndVoidOrdersIdr. belum_ada when payment-service or order-service cannot be read.

P-03.rules: P-01 minus P-02.refundIdr, same period and scope.

P-04.rules: Orders except BATAL and VOID, by creation day, every channel.

P-05.rules: P-01 / P-04, rounded to a whole rupiah. belum_ada with no orders.

P-06.rules: cancelled = BATAL orders created in the period; ratePct = cancelled / (orders + cancelled), one decimal. VOID counts in neither. belum_ada with no orders and no cancellations.

P-07.rules: Orders DELIVERED or COMPLETED (TERKIRIM or SELESAI) created in the period.

P-08.value: { app: { orders, revenueIdr }, counter: { orders, revenueIdr } }
P-08.rules: P-04 and P-01 split into the app (delivery) and the counter. belum_ada with no orders.

P-09.rules: Top 10 products by line value (no shipping, no order-level discount), so the sum is below P-01. label is the product name. Exact: every product of every readable stretch is read, merged, and only then ranked. belum_ada with no sales, or when a stretch has more than 2000 products.

P-10.rules: Shipping billed on orders that are not BATAL or VOID; already inside P-01.

P-11.rules: Always belum_ada: VAT per period is not computed anywhere yet.

P-13.rules: Orders by weekday x hour (WIB) and the top 10 destination cities; otherAreas holds the rest. Exact: every city of every readable stretch is merged before the top 10 is cut. belum_ada with no orders, or when a stretch has more than 2000 cities.

P-14.rules: Always ditahan: one customer is a group of 1 person, which the masking rule holds back (fewer than 3). Pending an owner decision on whether a top-customers list may be given.

U-01.rules: Payments settled (LUNAS) by paid date, less what was refunded of them, per method; CASH includes COD and the counter. A part-refunded payment counts for what stayed.

U-02.rules: Payments still MENUNGGU that were created in the period, per method and per age bucket (0-1, 2-3, 4-7, 8+ WIB calendar days up to today).

U-03.rules: Always belum_ada: receivables in rupiah are not computed anywhere yet.

U-04.value: { collectedIdr, depositedIdr, undepositedIdr, expectedIdr, shortfallIdr, surplusIdr }
U-04.rules: Three numbers: collectedIdr = cash settled on delivery orders by paid date; depositedIdr = courier deposits verified, by verification date; undepositedIdr = COD of orders delivered in the period that no deposit lists yet. expectedIdr = what the verified deposits were expected to be; shortfallIdr and surplusIdr are the short and the over of those deposits, each summed on its own (positive rupiah). belum_ada when a source cannot be read. Each figure follows its own depot, and the label says so: collectedIdr follows the depot of the ORDER; deposited, expected, shortfall and surplus follow the depot of the courier SHIFT that handed the cash in (one deposit can list orders of another depot, and deposits are lump sums, so they cannot be split per order); undepositedIdr follows the delivery depot.

U-05.value: { cashIdr, shiftVariance: { shifts, shortfallIdr, surplusIdr } | { status: "belum_ada", reason } }
U-05.rules: Counter cash: CASH settled at the counter by paid date, no opening float. shiftVariance = counted minus expected cash of the till shifts closed in the period, short and over apart; if the shift source cannot be read that sub-number is {status: belum_ada, reason} inside the answer, never omitted and never 0.

U-06.rules: Cashbook outflow less corrections, by transaction date, without stock-purchase categories. Outside net profit (L-07) but always to be named beside it.

U-07.rules: Days closed by the depots in the whole month; the sum of depot-days over the readable depots.

L-01.rules: HPP: units sold x the latest received PO buy price, no PO shipping. belum_ada when some unit sold has no buy price. For the running month the label says "bulan berjalan, sampai <today WIB>".

L-02.rules: Purchases received: POs completed in the period (goods x price + shipping), for cash flow only.

L-03.rules: Labour cost, for now BASE PAY AND ALLOWANCES ONLY (label: "gaji pokok dan tunjangan, belum termasuk bonus, lembur, THR dan BPJS perusahaan"). Only APPROVED or PAID slips count: a depot-month is finished when no slip is DRAFT and as many employees have an APPROVED or PAID slip as the month waits for (employed at any time in it: joined on or before its last day, not left before its first day; nobody expected = nothing to pay); any unfinished depot in scope makes the answer belum_ada, never 0. ditahan for a role without payrollRead.

L-04.rules: Courier commission, gross: earnings and incentives recorded in the period, by delivery depot.

L-05.rules: Approved expense claims by review date, by claim depot.

L-06.rules: Gross profit: revenue - HPP (L-01). belum_ada when HPP is. For the running month the label says "bulan berjalan, sampai <today WIB>".

L-07.rules: Net profit by the 17 Nov 2026 formula only: revenue - HPP - base pay and allowances (not bonus, overtime, THR, employer BPJS) - courier commission - expense claims - cashier refunds. Cashbook outflow is outside it; rent and electricity are not recorded. belum_ada when any element is unreadable or any depot-month payroll is not finished (as L-03: every employee of the month must have an approved or paid slip); ditahan for a role without payrollRead. The same numbers as /dashboard/network-pnl once the month is finished.

L-08.rules: L-07 / revenue, one decimal. belum_ada without profit or without revenue, or while payroll is not finished; ditahan like L-07.

L-09.rules: Net cash flow (arus kas, never "laba"): (revenue - refunds) - purchases received - salary paid - cashbook outflow. Its salary term takes every slip of the month, so it is belum_ada unless every depot-month payroll is finished (as L-03); ditahan for a role without payrollRead.

aiToken.description: Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> from POST /auth/api/v1/auth/handoff/token. ES256, aud hydromart-ai; carries the person's own role and depot.

metricId.description: The dictionary code of the metric (for example P-01), or meta.* for an answer about the API itself.

value.description: The number or structure answered. Null with belum_ada and ditahan, never 0.

unit.description: For example rupiah, persen, menit, depot, galon, orang.

asOf.description: When the answer was read, UTC.

reason.description: Present with belum_ada and ditahan: why, in words that can be quoted. Never carries personal data.

label.description: Optional. What the number is, where its name alone would mislead (for example "gaji pokok dan tunjangan" on L-03). Quote it beside the number. A label names a thing, never a person.

fromAt.description: The start of from, as a UTC instant (included).

toAt.description: The start of the day after to, as a UTC instant (excluded).

depotIds.description: The depots the answer covers: the caller's own depots, narrowed by the legal-entity matrix.

legalEntityIds.description: The legal entities those depots belonged to during the period, among the ones the caller's role may read.

MaskedCell.description: A group of people in a metric that counts them. Defined here so every later metric answers the same shape.

value.description: Null when held back; see flag.

flag.description: kurang dari 3: the group has 1 or 2 people. ditahan: held back only so a published total cannot give a small cell away.

code.description: BAD_REQUEST, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, RATE_LIMITED, INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR or SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.

message.description: For people reading logs. Route on statusCode and code.
